name: Upper Planes Pact and Project Lamordia
blurb: The newest D&D Beyond drop: the Upper Planes Pact and its two follow-on feats, and four Project Lamordia backgrounds for Ravenloft.
contents: 4 backgrounds: Discredited Neural Tuner, Fabricated Mind, Mutated Commuter, Reconstructed Runaway
3 feats: Upper Planes Pact (its effects go on the sheet), Elysium Diplomat, Ysgardian Warrior
Pact Seeker can now take the Upper Planes Pact
Build notes for each new background
about: From your book data update of 20 November 2026. Feat texts are summaries; Elysium Diplomat and Ysgardian Warrior weren’t fully confirmed when this was written.

featText.Upper Planes Pact:
Celestial Lore: Religion proficiency. Celestial Resistance: Resistance to Radiant damage. Detect Evil and Good always prepared; cast it once without a slot per Short or Long Rest, or with slots. Spellcasting ability: Int, Wis or Cha (chosen).
Leads to: Elysium Diplomat; Ysgardian Warrior.
featText.Elysium Diplomat:
+1 to a mental ability (Int, Wis or Cha). Celestial Communicator: learn two languages. Divine Calm: helps calm hostile creatures during negotiation. Quick Retreat: lets you slip away when talks fail. NOTE: exact mechanics for Divine Calm and Quick Retreat weren't publicly confirmed at time of update; check D&D Beyond.
Builds on: Upper Planes Pact.
featText.Ysgardian Warrior:
+1 to a physical ability (Str, Dex or Con). Ysgardian Spirit: after you become Bloodied, gain Advantage and a small damage bonus on an attack (once per Short Rest, per published reviews). NOTE: exact wording and numbers weren't publicly confirmed at time of update; check D&D Beyond.
Builds on: Upper Planes Pact.

Pact Seeker.impact: A warlock-style pact at level 1. Infernal Pact gives a resistance, Deception, and 30-ft sight through magical Darkness; Fey Pact gives Nature, two cantrips and a Deception/Persuasion reroll; Shadow Pact gives Darkvision and a Dim Light shroud; Upper Planes Pact gives Radiant Resistance and Religion. Greater pacts at L4 add strong upgrades (Infernal Bulwark's unarmoured AC).
Pact Seeker.watch: D&D Beyond Hero or Master tier subscription only. Infernal Pact was nerfed by the Aug 2026 errata (one resistance, 30-ft sight). Only one Planar Pact per character.

Discredited Neural Tuner.fit: Fighter (Eldritch Knight), Artificer, Rogue (Arcane Trickster), Wizard (Bladesinger)
Discredited Neural Tuner.impact: Gathered Whispers gives a Reaction that adds your PB to AC several times a day, plus Message and a free Augury. Str/Dex/Int suits Eldritch Knights and artificers.
Discredited Neural Tuner.watch: Medicine and Nature don't match the ability spread; thin starting kit; Ravenloft campaign required for Dark Gifts.

Fabricated Mind.impact: Echoing Soul adds two more skills, a swappable Expertise and a language, which makes a strong skill or face character on a Dex/Int/Cha spread.
Fabricated Mind.watch: No Con. A natural 1 can Incapacitate you for a turn.

Mutated Commuter.impact: Aberrant Anatomy gives Perception Expertise, 15-ft Blindsight and 1-hour breath-holding. Blindsight answers invisibility and darkness, and Con plus Wis/Cha suits casters.
Mutated Commuter.watch: Arcana and Investigation are Int skills on a non-Int spread. A natural 1 can Stun you.

Reconstructed Runaway.fit: Barbarian, Fighter, Cleric (Str), Druid, Ranger (Str), Monk
Reconstructed Runaway.impact: Symbiotic Being lets you spend Hit Dice to rescue failed saves (PB/day) and adds a skill and a language. Big Hit Dice plus Str/Con/Wis makes it a resilient front-liner.
Reconstructed Runaway.watch: A natural 1 risks being Charmed by the symbiote for hours, a big roleplay hook the DM controls.
